description: Tauri denies the webview every core command unless a capability grants it, and with no capability at all the overlay could not hear the Frame the Shell pushes it each tick - it drew nothing, silently. Listening for events is the only thing it needs: it holds no state, reads no files, and calls no command of its own. The glob covers every overlay: there is one per display, labelled overlay-0, overlay-1 and so on, and they all draw the same Character under the same rules.
